summary: Sprint 16.0 — Professional TradingView candlestick chart on Expo web preview. FRONTEND: 100% GREEN. Full flow verified: onboarding → welcome → email login (demo@mfb.in / demo1234) → Forex tab (TRADING BALANCE DEMO hero = ₹10,00,000, watchlist 5 symbols) → tap XAU/USD → symbol screen shows the new dark professional chart. Chart iframe at /api/chart/index.html is same-origin (HTTP 200), lightweight-charts.js is 200. Inside the iframe: 7 canvases render (>= 4 required), watermark='XAUUSD', legend shows 'XAUUSD O 4253.53 H 4253.53 L 4253.53 C 4253.53 +0.00% V 1'. All 7 timeframe testIDs (tf-1m tf-5m tf-15m tf-30m tf-1h tf-4h tf-1d) + 2 chart-type testIDs (chart-type-candles chart-type-line) are present and tappable. Switching 1m→5m→1H→1m each updates the legend OHLC values in real time (verified: 5m legend '4254.81 4255.57 4251.38 4251.38 V 4', 1h legend '4252.65 4255.57 4251.11 4251.38 V 20'). Chart-type toggle line↔candles works with no crash. Bid/ask/volume overlays visible in screenshots (blue horizontal price lines at bid=4250.95 ask=4251.80, colored volume histogram). ORDER FLOW: side-buy tap + lot-input 0.01 + place-order → window.confirm dialog fires 'Position opened. BUY 0.01 XAU/USD @ 4251.80' → OPEN=1, UNREALIZED P&L=-₹70.57 → close-btn POST /api/forex/positions/{id}/close → 200 → OPEN=0, EQUITY=₹10,00,287.08, no chart crashes. REGRESSION: Profile tab still has reset-demo-btn + demo-wallet-balance (₹10,00,287.08) intact from Sprint 15.1. Forex TRADING BALANCE hero intact. No red screen errors, no React Native crash, no /api errors observed in the network log for the full flow. Alert.alert on web now uses window.confirm/window.alert (confirmed working end-to-end via dialog handler).

static/chart/index.html locale pin ('en-US') is effective — no Intl throw observed, canvases render (7 canvases, not blank).
Live poll every 4s (POLL_MS=4000) — verified via network log (repeated GET /api/forex/positions and market candle updates).
Alert.alert on web is now using window.confirm — 'Position opened' confirm dialog fired correctly, matching the Sprint 15.1 web-Alert fix pattern.
